# Lumen Notes

> Lumen Notes is a fictional note-taking app that keeps plain markdown files, syncs them between devices and publishes notebooks in formats AI agents can read.

The site is small: a home page, product pages, documentation and release news.

## Main pages

- [Home page](https://good.example/): what Lumen Notes is
- [Features](https://good.example/features): editor, backlinks, tags and sync
- [Pricing](https://good.example/pricing): the free notebook and the team plans

## Docs

- [Install guide](https://good.example/docs/install): download, first folder, first note
- [Publishing a notebook](https://good.example/docs/publish): turn a notebook into a site

## News

- [Lumen Notes 2.0: published notebooks](https://good.example/news/lumen-notes-2-0)

## Optional
